translations.literal: Feng Jiye of Lingwu, Sun Xingyou of Dingzhou, and Tian Jingxian of Xingzhou were all promoted to Honorary Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu's Feng Jiye, Dingzhou's Sun Xingyou, and Xingzhou's Tian Jingxian were all promoted to Honorary Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 晉州楊廷璋加檢校太保；

translations.literal: Yang Tingzhang of Jinzhou was promoted to Honorary Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhou's Yang Tingzhang was promoted to Honorary Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事趙上交為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Zhao Shangjiao, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Shangjiao was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以樞密副使、右監門衛大將軍魏仁浦為樞密使、檢校太保。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Wei Renpu, Deputy Privy Commissioner and Major General of the Right Imperial Insignia Guard, was made Privy Commissioner and Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Deputy Privy Commissioner and Right Imperial Insignia Guard Major General Wei Renpu was made Privy Commissioner and Honorary Grand Guardian.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《東都事略》云：議者以仁浦不由科第進，世宗曰：「顧才何如耳！

translations.literal: (The 《Dongdu Shilue》 states: Discussants held that Renpu had not advanced through the civil service examinations. Shizong said: "What matters is talent, does it not!"
translations.idiomatic: (The Dongdu Shilue records that critics objected that Renpu had not risen through the examination system. Shizong replied, "What matters is ability, does it not!"

sentences.zh: 」遂用之。）〉

translations.literal: " Thereupon he was appointed.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙申，以中書舍人史館修撰、判館事劉溫叟為禮部侍郎，判館如故。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Liu Wen'ou, Secretariat Drafter, History Bureau compiler, and director of the bureau, was made Vice Minister of Rites; his duties at the bureau remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Secretariat Drafter, History Bureau compiler, and bureau director Liu Wen'ou was made Vice Minister of Rites while retaining his bureau duties.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，相州節度使王進卒。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Wang Jin, military governor of Xiangzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Xiangzhou military governor Wang Jin died.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔，以宣徽北院使吳延祚為右監門衛大將軍充職，以樞密院直學士、尚書右丞邊歸讜為尚書左丞充職。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day renshen, Wu Yanzuo, commissioner of the North Directorate of the Palace Affairs, was made Major General of the Right Imperial Insignia Guard to fill the post; Bian Guidan, direct academician of the Privy Council and Right Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Minister to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, Palace Affairs North Directorate commissioner Wu Yanzuo was appointed Right Imperial Insignia Guard Major General, and Privy Council direct academician and Right Vice Minister Bian Guidan was appointed Left Vice Minister, both to fill their new posts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸南莊，賜從臣射。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he visited the South Manor and granted archery to the attending officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor visited the South Manor and granted an archery contest to the officials in attendance.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以吏部侍郎顏衎為工部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On yisi, Yan Yan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Vice Minister of Personnel Yan Yan was made Minister of Works and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，同州節度使孫方諫卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Sun Fangjian, military governor of Tong, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Tong military governor Sun Fangjian died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前澤州刺史李彥崇責授右司禦副率。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Li Yanchong, former prefect of Ze, was demoted and appointed Deputy Commandant of the Right Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou former Ze Prefecture prefect Li Yanchong was demoted to Deputy Commandant of the Right Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 高平之役，帝與賊軍相遇，即令彥崇領兵守江豬嶺，以遏寇之歸路，彥崇初見王師已卻，即時而退，及劉崇兵敗，果由茲嶺而遁，故有是責。

translations.literal: In the campaign at Gaoping, when the emperor met the rebel army, he at once ordered Yanchong to lead troops to hold Jiangzhu Ridge and block the enemy's line of retreat. Yanchong, seeing at first that the imperial army had already withdrawn, immediately retreated as well. When Liu Chong's army was defeated, they indeed fled by this ridge; hence this punishment.
translations.idiomatic: During the Gaoping campaign, when the emperor encountered the enemy army, he ordered Yanchong to hold Jiangzhu Ridge and cut off their retreat. At first sight of the imperial forces withdrawing, Yanchong pulled back at once. When Liu Chong was defeated, the enemy did flee by that very ridge, and so Yanchong was punished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以金州防禦使王暉為同州留後。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wang Hui, defense commissioner of Jinzhou, was made acting commissioner of Tong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Jinzhou defense commissioner Wang Hui was made acting commissioner of Tong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吳越國內外都指揮使吳延福為寧國軍節度使、檢校太尉，從錢俶之請也。

translations.literal: On guichou, Wu Yanfu, commander-in-chief within and without the state of Wu-Yue, was made military governor of the Ningguo Army and Honorary Grand Commander, at Qian Chu's request.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wu-Yue's commander-in-chief within and without the realm Wu Yanfu was made Ningguo military governor and Honorary Grand Commander, at Qian Chu's request.

sentences.zh: 以太子少師宋彥筠為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Song Yanyun, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Song Yanyun was advanced to Grand Mentor and retired.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以兵部郎中兼太常博士尹拙為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yin Zhuo, Bureau Director of the Ministry of War concurrently Erudite of the Supreme Sacrifices, was made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Ministry of War bureau director and Erudite of the Supreme Sacrifices Yin Zhuo was made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，皇姑故福慶長公主追封燕國大長公主，李重進之母也。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the late Princess of Fortune and Celebration, the emperor's paternal aunt, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yan; she was Li Chongjin's mother.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor's late paternal aunt, Princess of Fortune and Celebration, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yan. She was Li Chongjin's mother.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以戶部郎中致仕景初為太僕卿致仕，宰臣範之父也。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jing Chu, former Bureau Director of the Ministry of Revenue who had retired, was made Grand Groom and retired; he was Minister Fan's father.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi retired Ministry of Revenue bureau director Jing Chu was made Grand Groom and retired from office. He was councilor Fan Zhi's father.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宜停華州鎮國軍，依舊為郡。

translations.literal: On jisi, it was ordered to abolish the Zhenguo Army at Hua Prefecture and restore it as a commandery as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Zhenguo Army at Hua Prefecture was abolished and the prefecture restored to its former status as a commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以給事中劉悅、康澄並為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Liu Yue and Kang Cheng, both Supervising Secretaries, were made Right Regular Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Supervising Secretaries Liu Yue and Kang Cheng were both made Right Regular Attendants.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以左散騎常侍裴巽為御史中丞，以御史中丞張煦為兵部侍郎，集賢殿學士、判院事司徒詡為吏部侍郎，以左散騎常侍薛沖乂為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Pei Xun, Left Regular Attendant, was made Censor-in-Chief; Zhang Xu, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of War; Sitao Xu, Jixian Hall academician and director of the institute, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Xue Chongyi, Left Regular Attendant, was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Left Regular Attendant Pei Xun was made Censor-in-Chief; Censor-in-Chief Zhang Xu was made Vice Minister of War; Jixian Hall academician and institute director Sitao Xu was made Vice Minister of Personnel; and Left Regular Attendant Xue Chongyi was made Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，以東京舊宅為皇建禪院。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day renshen, the old residence in the Eastern Capital was made Huangjian Chan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month the emperor's old residence in the Eastern Capital was converted into Huangjian Chan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以武安軍節度副使、知潭州軍府事周行逢為鄂州節度使，知潭州軍府事，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhou Xingfeng, deputy military governor of the Wu'an Army and administrator of Tanzhou military government, was made military governor of Ezhou and continued to administer Tanzhou military government, promoted to Honorary Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wu'an deputy military governor and Tanzhou administrator Zhou Xingfeng was made Ezhou military governor while continuing to administer Tanzhou, and was promoted to Honorary Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，右屯衛將軍薛訓除名，流沙門島，坐監雍兵倉，縱吏卒掊斂也。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Xue Xun, Major General of the Right Upright Guards, was stripped of his name and exiled to Liushamen Island, for supervising the Yongzhou military granary and allowing clerks and soldiers to extort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Right Upright Guards Major General Xue Xun was stripped of rank and exiled to Liushamen Island for supervising the Yongzhou military granary while allowing his clerks and soldiers to extort.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以右僕射致仕韓昭裔、左僕射致仕楊凝式並為太子太保致仕，以太子太傅致仕李肅為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On jihai, Han Zhaoyi and Yang Ningshi, retired Right and Left Vice Ministers, were made Grand Guardians of the Heir Apparent and retired; Li Su, retired Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai retired Right Vice Minister Han Zhaoyi and retired Left Vice Minister Yang Ningshi were both made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired; retired Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Li Su was made Grand Mentor and retired.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，斬宋州巡檢供奉官、副都知竹奉璘於寧陵縣，坐盜掠商船不捕獲也。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Zhu Fenglin, Songzhou patrol inspector and palace service official, deputy chief of the Inner Palace, was beheaded at Ningling County for plundering merchant vessels without capture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Songzhou patrol inspector and palace service official Zhu Fenglin, deputy chief of the Inner Palace, was beheaded at Ningling County for failing to capture pirates who had looted merchant ships.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，左羽林大將軍孟漢卿賜死，坐監納厚取耗餘也。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen, Meng Hanqing, Major General of the Left Feathered Forest, was granted death for supervising collection and taking a heavy surplus in collection.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen Left Feathered Forest Major General Meng Hanqing was ordered to take his own life for skimming excess grain while supervising tax collection.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以安州節度使李洪義為青州節度使，以貝州節度使王饒為相州節度使，以徐州節度使王晏為西京留守，以西京留守武行德為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Li Hongyi, military governor of Anzhou, was made military governor of Qingzhou; Wang Rao, military governor of Beizhou, was made military governor of Xiangzhou; Wang Yan, military governor of Xuzhou, was made Western Capital resident defender; Wu Xingde, Western Capital resident defender, was made military governor of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Anzhou military governor Li Hongyi was moved to Qingzhou; Beizhou military governor Wang Rao to Xiangzhou; Xuzhou military governor Wang Yan to Western Capital defender; and Western Capital defender Wu Xingde to Xuzhou military governor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以龍捷左廂都指揮使、泗州防禦使韓令坤為洋州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: On wushen, Han Lingkun, commander of the Dragon Swift Left Wing and defense commissioner of Sizhou, was made military governor of Yangzhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry;
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Dragon Swift Left Wing commander and Sizhou defense commissioner Han Lingkun was made Yangzhou military governor and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry;

sentences.zh: 以虎捷右廂都指揮使、永州防禦使李繼勛為利州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Li Jixun, commander of the Tiger Swift Right Wing and defense commissioner of Yongzhou, was made military governor of Lizhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger Swift Right Wing commander and Yongzhou defense commissioner Li Jixun was made Lizhou military governor and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太子太保致仕楊凝式卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Yang Ningshi, retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Yang Ningshi died.

sentences.zh: 詔安、貝二州依舊為防禦州，其軍額並停。

translations.literal: An edict restored An and Bei prefectures to defense prefectures as before; their army designations were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored An and Bei to defense prefectures as before and abolished their military designations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以今上為永州防禦使，依前殿前都虞候。

translations.literal: On renzi, the present sovereign was made defense commissioner of Yongzhou, retaining his former post as chief of staff of the Palace Front Division.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the present sovereign was made Yongzhou defense commissioner while retaining his post as chief of staff of the Palace Front Division.

sentences.zh: 戊午，監修國史李穀等上言曰：「竊以自古王者鹹建史官，君臣獻替之謀皆須備載，家國安危之道得以直書。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Li Gu and others, supervisors of the compilation of state history, submitted saying: "We venture to observe that since antiquity conquering kings have all established historiographers; the counsel of ruler and minister, whether offered or withdrawn, must all be fully recorded, and the paths of the state's safety and peril can thereby be written straight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Gu and the other supervisors of state history submitted a memorial: "We observe that since antiquity every conquering sovereign has established historiographers, so that counsel offered and withdrawn between ruler and minister might all be fully recorded and the paths of national safety and peril written without distortion.

sentences.zh: 歷代已來，其名不一。

translations.literal: Through the generations their titles have not been uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Through the ages their titles have varied.

sentences.zh: 人君言動，則起居註創於累朝；

translations.literal: For the ruler's words and deeds there is the Diaries of Activity and Repose, instituted across successive reigns;
translations.idiomatic: The ruler's words and deeds were recorded in the Diaries of Activity and Repose, instituted dynasty after dynasty;

sentences.zh: 輔相經綸，則時政記興於前代。

translations.literal: for the chancellor's governance, the Record of Current Administration arose in former ages.
translations.idiomatic: the chancellor's governance in the Record of Current Administration, which arose in earlier times.

sentences.zh: 然後采其事實，編作史書。

translations.literal: Only then were the facts gathered and compiled into historical books.
translations.idiomatic: Only then were the facts gathered and compiled into formal histories.

sentences.zh: 蓋緣聞見之間須有來處，記錄之際得以審詳。

translations.literal: This was because between what was heard and seen there had to be a source, and at the time of recording one could be thorough and exact.
translations.idiomatic: This was because what the historians heard and saw had to come from somewhere, so that what they recorded could be thorough and exact.

sentences.zh: 今之左右起居郎，即古之左右史也。

translations.literal: Today's Left and Right Diarists are the ancient Left and Right Historians.
translations.idiomatic: Today's Left and Right Diarists are the ancient Left and Right Historians.

sentences.zh: 唐文宗朝，命其官執筆，立於殿階螭頭之下，以紀政事。

translations.literal: In the reign of Tang Wenzong, these officers were ordered to hold the brush and stand below the dragon-head steps of the hall to record government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang Wenzong these officers were ordered to take up their brushes and stand below the dragon-head steps of the throne hall to record affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 後則明宗朝，命端明殿及樞密直學士，皆輪修日曆，旋送史官，以備纂修。

translations.literal: Later, in the reign of Mingzong, the Duanming Hall and direct academicians of the Privy Council were all ordered to take turns compiling the court calendar, which was promptly sent to the historiographers to supply material for compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, under Mingzong, Duanming Hall scholars and Privy Council direct academicians were ordered to compile the court calendar in rotation and send it promptly to the historiographers for use in compilation.

sentences.zh: 及近朝，此事皆廢，史官惟憑百司報狀，館司但取兩省制書，此外雖有訪聞，例非端的。

translations.literal: By recent times this practice had all been abandoned; historiographers relied only on reports from the hundred offices, and the institute took only edicts from the two secretariats; beyond this, though there might be inquiries and hearsay, as a rule it was not reliable.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times this practice had been abandoned entirely. Historiographers relied only on reports from the ministries, and the History Bureau took only edicts from the two secretariats. Whatever else they heard was, as a rule, unreliable.

sentences.zh: 伏自先皇帝創開昌運，及皇帝陛下纘嗣丕基，其聖德武功、神謀睿略，而皆萬幾宥密，丹禁深嚴，非外臣之所知，豈庶僚之可訪。

translations.literal: We bow before the fact that the late emperor opened a flourishing age, and Your Majesty has succeeded to the great foundation; his sagely virtue and martial achievement, divine stratagems and keen plans—all lie within the myriad affairs of the inner court, deep and secret within the vermilion forbidden precincts, not what outer ministers can know, how could common officials be consulted?
translations.idiomatic: Since the late emperor opened this flourishing age and Your Majesty has succeeded to the great foundation, his sagely virtue, martial achievement, divine stratagems, and keen plans all lie within the myriad affairs of the inner court, deep within the vermilion forbidden precincts. These are not matters outer ministers can know, nor subjects common officials may inquire into.

sentences.zh: 此後欲望以諮詢之事、裁制之規，別命近臣旋具抄錄，每當修撰日曆，即令封付史臣，庶國事無漏略之文，職業免疏遺之咎。

translations.literal: Hereafter we desire that on matters of consultation and rules of decision special orders be given to nearby ministers to prepare copies at once; whenever the court calendar is compiled, let these be sealed and delivered to the historiographers, so that state affairs may have no omitted passages and the profession may escape the fault of negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth we ask that matters of consultation and rules of decision be specially entrusted to nearby ministers to copy at once, and that whenever the court calendar is compiled these copies be sealed and delivered to the historiographers, so that state affairs suffer no omissions and the historiographers escape the charge of negligence.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 因命樞密直學士，起今後於樞密使處，逐月抄錄事件，送付史館。

translations.literal: Accordingly Privy Council direct academicians were ordered, beginning from now at the Privy Commissioner's office, to copy events month by month and send them to the History Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council direct academicians were accordingly ordered, beginning immediately, to copy monthly from the Privy Commissioner's records and deliver the copies to the History Bureau.

sentences.zh: 己未，供奉官郝光庭棄市，坐在葉縣巡檢日，挾私斷殺平人也。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Hao Guangting, palace service official, was executed in the marketplace for, while serving as patrol inspector of Ye County, killing a commoner in a private judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei palace service official Hao Guangting was executed in the marketplace for killing a commoner in a private judgment while serving as patrol inspector of Ye County.

sentences.zh: 是日大閱，帝親臨之。

translations.literal: That day there was a great review; the emperor personally attended it.
translations.idiomatic: That day a grand military review was held, and the emperor attended in person.

sentences.zh: 帝自高平之役，睹諸軍未甚嚴整，遂有退卻，至是命今上一概簡閱，選武藝超絕者，署為殿前諸班，因是有散員、散指揮使、內殿直、散都頭、鐵騎、控鶴之號。

translations.literal: Since the campaign at Gaoping the emperor had seen that the various armies were not very strict and orderly and had withdrawn; at this time he ordered the present sovereign to review them all comprehensively, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and appointing them to the various companies of the Palace Front; hence there came to be the designations Loose Companies, Loose Commanders, Inner Hall Direct, Loose Squad Chiefs, Iron Cavalry, and Crane Control.
translations.idiomatic: Since Gaoping the emperor had seen how poorly disciplined the armies were and how readily they fell back. He now ordered the present sovereign to review them all, selecting men of outstanding martial skill for the various companies of the Palace Front. Hence came the designations Loose Companies, Loose Commanders, Inner Hall Direct, Loose Squad Chiefs, Iron Cavalry, and Crane Control.

sentences.zh: 復命總戎者，自龍捷、虎捷以降，一一選之，老弱羸小者去之，諸軍士伍，無不精當。

translations.literal: He again ordered the commanders-in-chief, from Dragon Swift and Tiger Swift downward, to select one by one; the old, weak, emaciated, and small were removed, and in every army company nothing was not exact and proper.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the army commanders, from Dragon Swift and Tiger Swift downward, to inspect their troops one by one, removing the old, weak, and stunted until every company in every army was fit and exact.

sentences.zh: 由是兵甲之盛，近代無比，且減冗食之費焉。

translations.literal: By this the abundance of arms and armor had no parallel in recent times, and moreover superfluous consumption of provisions was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The army's arms and armor were thereafter unmatched in recent memory, and the cost of feeding useless mouths was reduced as well.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：顯德元年，上謂侍臣曰：「侍衛兵士老少相半，強懦不分，蓋徇人情，不能選練。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: In the first year of Xiande, the emperor said to his attending ministers: "The palace guard soldiers are half old and half young, strong and weak undistinguished; this indulges personal feeling and cannot select and drill.
translations.idiomatic: (The Institutions of the Five Dynasties records that in the first year of Xiande the emperor told his ministers, "Our palace guards are half old men and half young, with no distinction between the strong and the weak. We indulge personal ties and cannot drill them properly.

sentences.zh: 今春朕在高平，與劉崇及蕃軍相遇，臨敵有指使不前者，茍非朕親當堅陣，幾至喪敗。

translations.literal: This spring I was at Gaoping and met Liu Chong and the barbarian army; facing the enemy there were those under command who would not advance; if I had not personally taken the firm line, we would nearly have suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: This spring at Gaoping I met Liu Chong and the Khitan army. Some of my officers would not advance when ordered. Had I not personally held the line, we would nearly have been destroyed.

sentences.zh: 況百戶農夫，未能贍一甲士，且兵在精不在眾，宜令一一點選，精銳者升在上軍，怯懦者任從安便，庶期可用，又不虛費。

translations.literal: Moreover, a hundred farming households cannot support one armored soldier; moreover, in soldiers quality matters, not numbers; it is fitting to order selection one by one—the sharp and elite to be raised into the upper armies, the timid and weak allowed to go where they please, so that we may expect usefulness and not waste in vain.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred farming households cannot even support one armored soldier. Soldiers depend on quality, not numbers. Each man should be inspected: the elite raised into the upper armies, the timid allowed to go where they will, so that what we keep is useful and nothing is wasted.

sentences.zh: 」先是，上按於高平，觀其退縮，慨然有懲革之志。

translations.literal: " Earlier, when the emperor inspected at Gaoping and saw them withdraw, he sighed and had the will to punish and reform.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, when he inspected the troops at Gaoping and watched them fall back, he had resolved to reform them.

sentences.zh: 又以驍勇之士，多為外諸侯所占，如是召募天下豪傑，不以草澤為阻，在於闕下，躬親試閱，選武藝超絕及有身首者，分署為殿前諸班。）〉

translations.literal: Moreover, because bold and brave men were mostly taken by outer feudal lords, he therefore recruited heroes throughout the empire, not obstructed by commoners in the wilds; at the court he personally tested and reviewed them, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and of stature, and assigning them in divisions to the various companies of the Palace Front.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Bold warriors had also been snapped up by regional lords, so he recruited heroes from across the realm without regard to humble birth. At court he personally tested them, selecting men of outstanding skill and imposing stature for the various companies of the Palace Front.)〉

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，以太子賓客石光贊為兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, Shi Guangzan, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of War and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin Mentor of the Heir Apparent Shi Guangzan was made Minister of War and retired.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鎮州節度使曹英卒。

translations.literal: On renwu, Cao Ying, military governor of Zhenzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhenzhou military governor Cao Ying died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以澶州節度使郭崇為鎮州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Guo Chong, military governor of Cangzhou, was made military governor of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Cangzhou military governor Guo Chong was made Zhenzhou military governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以荊南節度副使、歸州刺史高保勖為寧江軍節度使、檢校太尉，充荊南節度行軍司馬。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Gao Baoxu, deputy military governor of Jingnan and prefect of Guizhou, was made military governor of the Ningjiang Army and Honorary Grand Commander, filling the post of Jingnan campaign army vice marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Jingnan deputy military governor and Guizhou prefect Gao Baoxu was made Ningjiang military governor and Honorary Grand Commander, serving as Jingnan campaign vice marshal.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔宰臣李穀監築河堤。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict ordered Councilor Li Gu to supervise construction of the river embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu councilor Li Gu was ordered to supervise construction of the river embankment.

sentences.zh: 先是，鄆州界河決，數州之地洪流為患，故命穀治之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the border river in Yanzhou had burst its banks; in the territory of several prefectures raging floods were a calamity; therefore Gu was ordered to remedy it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the border river in Yanzhou had burst its banks, and raging floods had afflicted several prefectures. Li Gu was therefore assigned to remedy the disaster.

sentences.zh: 役丁夫六萬人，三十日而罷。

translations.literal: Sixty thousand corvée laborers were employed; after thirty days the work ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty thousand laborers were mobilized, and the work was completed in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，太子太師侯益以本官致仕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, Hou Yi, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, retired in that same office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiyou Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Hou Yi retired in that same rank.
